source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Full mouth ultrasonic supragingival scaling, polishing and medication. OHI oral hygiene education, education on brushing teeth, flossing, and using interstitial brushes. 5. Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
